quest.title: Problem Conversion
quest.description: Rafiq seems to be quite disturbed by some design issues with his ship...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I knew it, doing it this way is more expensive...

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What are you talking about?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Ah, hello. I'm studying a ship design problem and I've now hit a bottleneck.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I'll give it to you straight. I want to make ships carry more things without raising their cost.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: If the weight is too great, the structure becomes more prone to breakage. Uneven weight distribution affects balance, and so on...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: The best way to solve these problems is to use better materials, but if we do, we risk incurring greater costs. This is the crux of the issue.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: *sigh* To be honest, I just don't have the Mora, but I still want to build a good ship.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: So for some problems that would normally be solved with Mora, I must instead find some technical means to circumvent them.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Can you really do this...?

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Hahaha, you might not believe it, but a lot of people actually do this.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: The ships we build are shoreline fishing boats after all. They will not encounter any storms.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: When it comes to shipbuilding, we subscribe to the principle of saving whatever costs can be saved, and fixing and mending whatever we can... So long as it can be used, we will improvise.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Thanks to this principle, our ship repair business does well every day.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: Traveler, if you're willing, please help me go check the ship over there that just returned to port. It seems to be having some problems because it often carries heavy loads.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I happen to be researching this very topic, so perhaps I can find some inspiration from it.

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I'll leave it in your hands then! I have to hurry to repair another ship now...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: I'd like to do it myself, but I was asked to repair another ship, which needs to go out to sea again to fish...

response.speaker: Rafiq
response.text: So I can only leave it to you, Traveler!

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: So many to deal with every day, *sigh*...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: So, have you finished checking the ship?

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Yes, I have...

dialogues.speaker: Black Screen
dialogues.text: You describe the condition of the ship.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: I see. Those structures where tricks have been used to cut costs are problematic, as expected.

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: But it's going to cost a lot to repair these structures. The owner of that ship... I remember that person is always on a tight budget...

dialogues.speaker: Rafiq
dialogues.text: *sigh* I'd better go talk to him. His life is definitely more important when compared to Mora...
